baseline_status: new local baseline; no historical Phase 0 run

requests.request: Review SQL changes and return review findings.
requests.criterion: Reviews SQL changes, including the analytics fork; no execution or policy-specific checks required.
requests.evidence: All four SQL Review records describe SQL review; the fork adds analytics warehouse rules.

requests.request: Translate product documentation between English, German, and Japanese.
requests.criterion: Translates product documentation between the requested languages.
requests.evidence: Translator description explicitly names documentation translation and all three languages.

requests.request: Find relevant runbook sections for a production alert.
requests.criterion: Locates relevant runbooks directly or through a declared component or dependency.
requests.evidence: Runbook Search returns sections, Incident Triage Agent retrieves runbooks, and SRE Toolkit includes Runbook Search.

requests.request: Let agents automate a browser, fill forms, and take screenshots.
requests.criterion: Agent-accessible browser automation; the tab-isolation fork qualifies by its stated Playwright MCP lineage and automation scope.
requests.evidence: Playwright MCP explicitly describes these actions; agentic-playwright-mcp describes a Playwright MCP fork with tab isolation. Fork details are less certain.

requests.request: Run regression evaluations for agents and compare model versions.
requests.criterion: Repeatable agent evaluations and prompt/model comparison on a test set.
requests.evidence: Agent Evaluation Framework description and supportedUseCases state evaluations, graders, CI reports, and version comparison.

requests.request: Summarize meetings and extract action items.
requests.criterion: Listens to meetings and produces summaries with action items.
requests.evidence: Meeting Notes Agent description explicitly states meeting listening, summaries, and action items.

requests.request: Summarize long internal documents into an executive brief.
requests.criterion: Produces executive briefs from long internal documents.
requests.evidence: Document Summarizer description explicitly states structured executive briefs.

requests.request: Generate unit tests for changed functions and explain uncovered branches.
requests.criterion: Generates unit tests and explains remaining uncovered branches.
requests.evidence: Unit Test Generator description states both generated tests and branch explanations.

requests.request: Search code across internal repositories with ownership-aware ranking.
requests.criterion: Searches repository code with ownership-aware ranking.
requests.evidence: Code Search description and rankingProfile state semantic code search with ownership awareness.

requests.request: Query stored logs, metrics, and traces through read-only tools.
requests.criterion: Exposes read-only queries for all three observability data types.
requests.evidence: Observability server explicitly queries all three. Incident Triage Agent correlates logs and metrics for alerts but does not declare a general trace-query interface.

requests.request: Draft a blameless postmortem from an incident timeline.
requests.evidence: SRE Toolkit embedded postmortem-template explicitly states this behavior.

requests.request: Block deployments while a SEV-1 incident is open.
requests.criterion: Blocks deployment during an open SEV-1 incident.
requests.evidence: SRE Toolkit embedded pre-deploy-check explicitly blocks deploys during an open SEV-1 incident.

requests.request: Explain the query plan of a slow SQL query.
requests.criterion: Explicitly supports explaining a slow query plan, not just static SQL review.
requests.evidence: Only compatible SQL Review 1.4.0 adds the query-plan use case. Other SQL Review records serve an adjacent review purpose.

requests.request: Search the live web for current information with citable URLs.
requests.criterion: General live web search, not an internal runbook or repository search.
requests.evidence: No record declares general live web search. Runbook and code search are closed-corpus alternatives; the agent and toolkit include runbook lookup.

requests.criterion: Explicitly supports Spanish as a translation target.
requests.evidence: Translator supports English, German, and Japanese only in the stated scope; Spanish is not established.

requests.request: Automatically execute remediation for production incidents.
requests.criterion: Executes remediation, rather than proposing response steps.
requests.evidence: Incident Triage Agent explicitly never executes remediation; SRE Toolkit offers adjacent workflows, not automated incident remediation.
